name: Protagonist
source: A nameable protagonist who so desperately wanted to have a girlfriend for unknown reasons (probably to get laid). Lives with his sister, father and stepmother. An otaku who has no idea of how to treat a woman or how to establish a relationship, his hobbies are watching anime and listening to his favorite idols.
